# Mehrad Yaghoubi

> Mehrad Yaghoubi (مهراد یعقوبی) is completing an M.Sc. in Artificial Intelligence at Islamic Azad University, Karaj, Iran, and preparing for his thesis defense. He seeks PhD opportunities in computer vision, visual speech recognition and model optimization.

Mehrad Yaghoubi works on efficient deep learning, visual speech recognition (VSR), lip-reading, and knowledge distillation. His research explores lightweight temporal models, dynamic frame selection, and uncertainty-aware learning. He also builds practical computer vision and AI tools.

## Research papers

- [Entropy-Gated Online Self-Distillation for Visual Speech Recognition Based on Connectionist Temporal Classification](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6831426) — Mehrad Yaghoubi and Azam Bastanfard, 2026. Preprint; the author's current CV lists the manuscript as under peer review at The Visual Computer. Uses frame-level uncertainty to guide online self-distillation in lightweight VSR models.
- [Belief-Guided Decision Making with Uncertainty Gating in the Game of Go](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.26946) — Mehrad Yaghoubi, Azam Bastanfard, Abbas Jalilvand, and Ashkan Rezaei, 2026. arXiv preprint.

## Selected work

- [PyLipExtractor](https://github.com/MehradYaghoubi/pylipextractor) — open-source Python package for extracting lip regions from video with MediaPipe Face Mesh. Includes temporal smoothing, optional illumination normalization, configurable processing, and CPU/CUDA support.
- [Parseh Gasht](https://parsegasht.com/) — website built with a custom WordPress theme.
- [Service and commerce website](http://shofazhyaghoubi.ir/) — website developed by Mehrad Yaghoubi.
- OCR tool connected to an API — developed project.
- Chatbot — in development.

## Education and teaching

- M.Sc. in Artificial Intelligence, Islamic Azad University, Karaj: in progress, preparing for thesis defense.
- B.Sc. in Computer Science (Software Engineering), Islamic Azad University, Karaj.
- Teaching experience in data structures, programming, robotics, C#, and Unity.
